add_key.label: Label
cloud_api.cap_none_hint: This provider has a card but nothing uses its key yet.
cloud_api.unverified_hint: Stored and active, but never confirmed with a real call. Click Test.
cloud_api.test_image_hint: Draw one test image with exactly this key (no switching to another key or provider)
add_key.email_label: Email (only for a Global API Key)
add_key.account_required: Account ID is required for Cloudflare.
add_key.cloudflare_hint: Paste an API Token (Bearer). For a Global API Key, also fill in Email.
models.src_api: List fetched from the provider's API at {when}.
models.src_builtin: Shipped default list — may be outdated. Click "Fetch from API" to update.
cloud_api.muse_hint: Muse has no API key: TubeCLI types into muse.ai inside a browser profile that is signed in to it. Pick that profile. A closed profile opens in the background on the first request. Each account answers one request at a time — add more accounts below to draw several pictures at once.
cloud_api.muse_turns_hint: TubeCLI reuses one Muse side chat for this many requests, then starts a new one.
cloud_api.muse_cleared: Muse is turned off (no browser profile).
cloud_api.muse_pick_first: Pick the browser profile first, then save.
cloud_api.muse_closed: Profile {profile} is closed — it opens in the background on the first request.
cloud_api.muse_not_signed: ❌ {profile} is not signed in to muse.ai — open the profile, sign in to muse.ai, then check again.
cloud_api.muse_extra_hint: Tick other browser profiles, each signed in to a different muse.ai account. Requests are spread over all accounts — 3 accounts draw 3 pictures at once.
cloud_api.muse_lanes_hint: Keep 1 to be safe. 2 worked in a short test, but Muse may slow down or flag an account that sends many requests at once.
cloud_api.muse_saved_pool: Saved — Muse uses {profile} and {n} more account(s).
cloud_api.muse_remotes_hint: Other machines running TubeCLI with their own Muse accounts. One per line: base URL (…/api/v1/muse) | node key | seats. Each node adds that many parallel seats; the browsers run there, not here.
cloud_api.muse_node_key_hint: Lets another TubeCLI use this machine's Muse accounts through /api/v1/muse/v1/*. Make a key, then paste it into that machine's remote-node line.
cloud_api.muse_node_key_made: Node key made and saved — copy it now, it is shown only once.
